decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to control the game by disrupting opponents' strategies with a variety of counterspells and removal spells. The deck aims to manipulate the board state in your favor using Aminatou's abilities to blink key creatures and permanents, generating card advantage and protecting your own threats. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Teferi, Time Raveler to help maintain control of the game. By utilizing a combination of instant-speed interaction and versatile threats, this archetype seeks to outmaneuver opponents and establish a dominant position in the match, ultimately leading to victory through strategic play and careful resource management.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively ramp up mana through various mana dorks and enchantments, allowing the player to play various threats and disruption spells early in the game. The deck also utilizes graveyard recursion and sacrifice synergies to maintain board presence and pressure the opponent. Grist, The Hunger Tide serves as the commander and provides a powerful engine for card advantage and creature removal. The deck is designed to overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and disruption spells, while also having the flexibility to adapt to different game states and strategies through its diverse card selection.

The deck focuses on utilizing a variety of spells and creatures to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining a strong board presence. It includes a mix of removal, counterspells, card draw, and tutors to control the game and find key pieces quickly. The commanders, Wernog and Bjorna, provide flexibility and synergy with each other, allowing for different lines of play depending on the situation. Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion adds additional value by allowing a permanent to be recurred each turn. The deck aims to pressure the opponent while disrupting their game plan, ultimately leading to victory through efficient and strategic play.

The main focus of this deck is to assemble powerful combos using Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy's abilities to ramp and generate mana, as well as abuse his ability to untap nonland permanents for extra value. The deck includes a mix of mana dorks, mana rocks, and ramp spells to ensure a fast start. Additionally, there are cards like Birthing Pod, Neoform, and Eldritch Evolution to tutor for key combo pieces. The deck also features powerful artifacts like Basalt Monolith and Dramatic Reversal to generate infinite mana, which can be used to cast big threats like Hydroid Krasis or Walking Ballista for the win. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combos and overwhelm opponents with powerful plays.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly reduce the opponent's life total, while also utilizing sacrifice outlets and graveyard recursion to provide a constant stream of threats. Juri, Master of the Revue serves as the commander, providing recursion for sacrificed creatures and a potential win condition with her ability to deal damage directly to opponents. The deck includes a combination of cheap creatures, burn spells, and sacrifice outlets to apply pressure from multiple angles, with a focus on efficiency and resilience. The mana base is built to support the aggressive strategy, with a mix of dual lands and fetch lands to ensure consistent access to the necessary colors of mana.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by consistently countering opponents' spells, removing their threats, and disrupting their strategy with a wide range of interactive cards. The deck aims to maintain card advantage through various draw spells and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Jace, the Mind Sculptor. The deck also has a strong creature package featuring versatile threats like Snapcaster Mage and True-Name Nemesis, backed up by efficient removal spells and counter magic. With a diverse mana base featuring dual lands and fetch lands, the deck is able to consistently cast its spells and adapt to different situations, making it a formidable opponent in 1 vs 1 matches.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage, while also utilizing the commander, Shorikai, Genesis Engine, to generate value and incremental advantage. The deck includes a wide range of control tools such as counterspells like Counterspell and Force of Will, removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Detention Sphere, and card draw spells like Fact or Fiction and Brainstorm. The deck aims to disrupt opponents' game plans, protect its own key pieces, and eventually win the game through incremental advantage and efficient threats. By controlling the game and out-valuing opponents, the deck seeks to grind out wins in the long game.

This control deck focuses on utilizing enchantments to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage. Sythis, Harvest's Hand serves as the commander, drawing cards whenever an enchantment enters the battlefield. The deck includes various enchantresses like Argothian Enchantress and Eidolon of Blossoms to draw even more cards. The deck also has a strong mana ramp package with cards like Utopia Sprawl and Wild Growth to accelerate its mana production. It aims to lock down the opponent with cards like Solitary Confinement and Suppression Field while setting up win conditions like Emrakul, the Promised End and Finale of Devastation. The deck seeks to grind out value and outvalue the opponent through its enchantment-based control strategy.
